product_summary: Website angtech.co.in (ANG Technologies, ISO 9001:2008, set up 2012, New Delhi; reg. address 113, A-115, 1st Floor, Vakil Chamber, Shakarpur, Delhi-110092; corporate office SF-3, Reliable Arcade, Kaushambi, Ghaziabad UP 201010). Real product lines listed on the site: Online UPS systems (single- and three-phase, industrial grade), industrial/enterprise inverters incl. bi-directional inverters, solar inverters, servo-controlled voltage stabilizers, power factor correctors, active harmonic filters, isolation transformers, ultra isolation transformers, K-rated transformers, battery chargers, batteries (SMF/VRLA, industrial tubular, Ni-Cd). HS mapping: UPS and static inverters -> 8504.40 (matches declared); isolation/ultra-isolation/K-rated transformers -> 8504.31/8504.32/8504.33/8504.34; active harmonic filters and power factor correction equipment -> 8537.10 or 8543.70 (harmonic filter panels are not 8504.40); servo stabilizers -> 8504.31/8504.40 depending on construction (voltage regulators); battery chargers -> 8504.40 (static converters) but tubular/Ni-Cd batteries -> 8507.20/8507.80; control/measurement panels -> 9032.89.
comment: Declared 8504.40 is correct for the core UPS/inverter/charger line but covers only part of the catalogue: transformers (8504.31-8504.34), harmonic filters/PFC (8537.10/8543.70) and batteries (8507.20/8507.80) fall outside it. Status: partial. Industry label 'Энергетика' is imprecise - the company is a power-conditioning / electrical-equipment supplier, not a power generator. Trader signs: the site itself states the firm was set up in 2012 'as a business partner of Global power conditioning companies' and describes itself as a supplier, not a manufacturer; no own plant or production line is claimed on the homepage - role assessed as trader (possibly manufacturer_trader for assembled panels, unverified). All product lines are 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no customs line, invoice or B-L record was available to corroborate any specific item; the product list is taken from the company's own website only. Sub-pages (products, solar-inverters, online-ups, about-us) returned 404 and web search was unavailable, so catalogue depth and any HS-specific declarations could not be verified further. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research was performed per scope.
